title: Predicting the oxidation states of Mn ions in the oxygen-evolving complex of photosystem II using supervised and unsupervised machine learning.
summary: Decision tree and k-means models trained on Mn crystallographic compounds assign oxidation states to PSII oxygen-evolving complex structures, a specific structural-biology result with the AI role identified; evaluation compares against XFEL and CryoEM structures.
